description: Roadmap #7 — the governance surface is itself budgeted. A per-category cap on the framework's own enforcement machinery (gates, CLI verbs, audit checks) so it can't grow faster than dead surface retires — the cure for F3/F4 becoming the next F3/F4. To exceed a cap, either retire/merge something OR add a waiver row here with a reason (each waiver raises that category's effective cap by exactly one, and shows as visible debt in `maddu audit`). Counts are read from ground truth (discoverGates / bin COMMANDS / the audit's own check registry) — nothing is hand-maintained. Enforced by checkGovernanceBudget in commands/audit.mjs via template/maddu/runtime/lib/governance-budget.mjs.

gates.note: builtin enforcement gates (template/maddu/runtime/gates/builtin/*.mjs). Raised 75→76 (acceptance-proof track PR-2, 2026-08-11, plan pr2-gate-plan): +acceptance-proven — the warn-severity advisory readout of acceptance proof state (does the active goal's every verifiable success condition hold a LIVE RED→GREEN proof against a frozen declared oracle, at the tier the declaration named). Read-only by construction: it executes no declared command — observation belongs to `maddu orient` and `maddu loop ralph` — and renders from the same lib/acceptance-view.mjs those surfaces render from, so a gate and an orient can never report different proof state for one condition. Permanently advisory: `maddu ci pin` structurally refuses warn-severity gates (commands/ci.mjs:169, :214), which is the honest ceiling for a signal whose subject can re-declare the goal underneath it. Nothing retired: no existing gate renders acceptance proof state — tracked-source-drift watches PINNED verdict machinery for drift and says nothing about whether a declared command was ever observed to exit nonzero then zero. Prior: 74→75 (memory-recall track, 2026-08-03, plan pln_20260803035706_7040): +memory-injection-bounded — the critical gate re-verifying every MEMORY_INJECTED event (≤8 facts, ≤16KB, every fact currently approved + non-superseded, re-derived from the spine). A deliberate, attributed raise for the injection-safety half of the recall feature: without it, the 'only approved facts reach agent context' law is enforced in exactly one pure function with no audit backstop. Nothing retired: no existing gate polices memory injection (skill-injection-bounded polices the sibling SKILL_INJECTED surface only). Prior: 73→74: +discipline-observed, the self-discipline surfacing gate — reports whether Máddu's session rituals are current (session/lane/goal-or-plan present, slice-stops fresh, work committed) and, critically, whether the PreToolUse enforcement hook is actually installed for the configured governance mode (Codex flagged that a repo can configure strict enforcement yet never wire the hook, so discipline silently does nothing). A deliberate, attributed raise for a permanent enforcement-observability surface backing the self-discipline directive (make Máddu enforce its own rituals) — not temporary debt. Nothing retired: no existing gate reports ritual freshness or hook wiring. Prior: 72→73 +skill-no-external-refs (auto-injectable skills locally resident — closes the audit-time half of the skill URL-swap attack surface); 71→72 (roadmap #12c phase 3) +replica-untracked; 70→71 (v1.94.0, #12b phase 7) +event-schema-complete.

verbs.note: top-level CLI verbs (bin/maddu.mjs COMMANDS). Raised 72->73 (memory-recall track, 2026-08-03, plan pln_20260803035706_7040): +wiki — the wiki's first CLI surface (list|drift|page|sync|rebuild). Required to close a confirmed data-loss defect: CLI slice-stops never reached the wiki (355 of 619 live stops missing at fix time) and the backfill (`wiki sync`) needs a CLI on-ramp — the bridge-only rebuild route both destroys hand-edits and requires the optional bridge to be up. Nothing retired: no existing verb reads or repairs .maddu/wiki. Prior: 71->72 (SLM-governance phase 3, 2026-07-06, plan pln_20260706133422_0f60): +model — the SLM-factory governance verb (hash-pinned manifest ingest -> contract-1.1.0 MODEL_* events; promotion via an always-on stage-keyed approval ride; Maddu records the factory, never trains). Flagged as verb #72 in the phase-0 design doc (docs/research/slm-governance-design.md par.6/par.11) BEFORE the build — the EXP-phase-3 precedent. Nothing retired: no existing verb records ML-lifecycle manifests. Prior: 70->71 (EXP roadmap phase 3): +evolve, the recommend-only evolution planner; the companion experience verb consumed the last headroom under the old cap.

audit-checks.note: maddu audit coherence checks (reusable gates surfaced + audit-only checks)

selfTest.note: relative self-test latency ceiling, PER PROFILE (v1.138.0, audit register F1). The last recorded run in .maddu/state/self-test-last-run.json is judged against the baseline for ITS profile: WARN (never FAIL) when durationMs exceeds baselineMs * (1 + tolerancePct/100). A run whose profile has no entry here (smoke, or a report that predates profile recording) is reported UNSUPPORTED — visible, never folded into PASS — and a checkout with no recorded run reports SKIP by name. Raise a baseline deliberately when the suite legitimately grows, and say why here. History: 36000→48000→115000 across v1.93.0 (roadmap #12a; 113 tasks; the dominant driver was ci-command invoking `maddu ci` 7× sequentially). One flat number then sat unchanged while the quick profile grew to ~234 tasks and the full profile to 240, so `maddu audit` WARNed on every run (a 700s full run judged 508% over a 115s quick-era baseline). Re-baselined 2026-09-13 from measured runs on the reference Windows 11 workstation (the larger platform wins, both noted): quick 521–713s over nine runs 2026-09-06..09-08 (median ≈570s) → 600000; full 667–702s over four runs 2026-09-06..09-09 → 720000. GitHub ubuntu-latest runs the quick profile in ≈444s (three runs 2026-09-09) and WSL Ubuntu 22.04 on the same workstation in 363s (2026-09-13, 233 pass · 0 fail · 4 dep-skips). The two heavy suites alone measure 18s + 9s on WSL Ubuntu 22.04 (2026-09-13); the earlier full-profile OOM kills were the whole profile under memory pressure, not these suites.
